words.name: _adler
words.doc: The Adler-32 checksum of the bytes as an unsigned integer, b in the high 16 bits and a in the low 16 (private helper of adler32:checksum).

words.name: _block-dec
words.doc: Decrypt one 16-byte block with raw AES (private block function for the blockmode layer).

words.name: _block-enc
words.doc: Encrypt one 16-byte block with raw AES (private block function for the blockmode layer).

words.name: _check-key
words.doc: Raise E_RANGE unless the key is 16, 24 or 32 bytes (private helper of aes:encrypt).

words.name: _crypt
words.effect: ( data:bytes key:bytes iv:bytes mode:str padding:bool decrypt:bool -- bytes )
words.doc: AES in ECB, CBC, CFB or CTR mode over noble (private helper of aes:encrypt and aes:decrypt).

words.name: _gcm
words.effect: ( data:bytes key:bytes iv:bytes aad:bytes decrypt:bool -- bytes )
words.doc: AES-GCM over noble, the tag appended to the ciphertext (private helper of aes:encrypt and aes:decrypt).

words.name: _unwrap
words.doc: AES Key Unwrap (RFC 3394), checking the integrity value (private helper of aes-kw:unwrap).

words.name: _wrap
words.doc: AES Key Wrap (RFC 3394) of the data under the key-encryption key (private helper of aes-kw:wrap).

words.name: _decode
words.doc: The one AMF0 or AMF3 value in the bytes, as a JSON value (private helper of amf:decode).

words.name: _encode
words.doc: A JSON value as one AMF0 or AMF3 value (private helper of amf:encode).

words.name: _log2
words.doc: Base-2 logarithm of a positive number (private helper of analysis:entropy).

words.name: _derive
words.effect: ( password:bytes salt:bytes t:int m:int p:int length:int type:str encoded:bool -- bytes )
words.doc: Argon2 (RFC 9106) over the audited noble library, raw or as a PHC string (private helper of argon2:derive).

words.name: _verify
words.doc: Whether the password matches a PHC encoded Argon2 hash (private helper of argon2:compare).

words.name: _aead
words.effect: ( data:bytes key:bytes nonce:bytes ad:bytes decrypt:bool -- bytes )
words.doc: Ascon-AEAD128 (SP 800-232), the tag appended to the ciphertext (private helper of ascon:encrypt and ascon:decrypt).

words.name: _hash
words.doc: Ascon-Hash256 (SP 800-232): 32 bytes (private helper of ascon:hash).

words.name: _mac
words.doc: Ascon-Mac: 16 bytes under a 16-byte key (private helper of ascon:mac).

words.name: _pem-scan
words.doc: The PEM blocks of a text as records of label, headers and the Base64 body as ASCII bytes (private helper of asn1:pem-decode).

words.name: _string
words.doc: The text of the content of an ASN.1 string type by its universal tag (private helper of asn1:text).

words.name: oid-decode
words.doc: The dotted text of the content bytes of an OBJECT IDENTIFIER (no tag and length): 2a864886f70d010101 is 1.2.840.113549.1.1.1. Arcs may be any size (2.25.<128-bit number> works). Empty, cut-short, non-minimal or longer than 4096 bytes is E_COERCE.

words.name: oid-encode
words.doc: The content bytes of an OBJECT IDENTIFIER written in dotted form (surrounding white space ignored). At least two arcs, the first 0, 1 or 2, the second below 40 under 0 and 1, digits only without leading zeros; anything else is E_COERCE.

words.name: oid-find
words.doc: The dotted OID of a name or abbreviation of the table (exact match first, then ignoring case), or the empty string.

words.name: oid-name
words.doc: The name of a known object identifier (OpenSSL's, such as sha256WithRSAEncryption or subjectAltName), or the empty string when it is not in the table.

words.name: oid-short
words.doc: The abbreviation a distinguished name prints for an attribute type (2.5.4.3 is CN, 2.5.4.10 is O), or the empty string.

words.name: parse-in
words.doc: The DER (BER with definite lengths) elements found in data from start to end, as a list of node records: class (universal, application, context, private), constructed, tag, offset and hlen (where the element and its content start, in data), len (content bytes), value (the content of a primitive element; empty for a constructed one) and children (a list of nodes; empty for a primitive one). Nesting deeper than max-depth, an indefinite length, an end-of-contents marker, a cut-short header and a child that runs past its parent are E_COERCE; a window outside the data is E_RANGE; a tree whose records would pass the value limit stops with E_LIMIT_VALUE. Shared word of the asn1 vocabulary.

words.name: _read
words.doc: The container metadata of an audio file as a record of info (a list of name and value pairs), tags (a list of lines) and id3 (true for MP3). MP3, FLAC, Ogg (Vorbis, Opus, Speex), WAV and MP4 or M4A; anything else, and a structure that runs past the data, is E_COERCE (private helper of audio-meta:extract).

words.name: _decode
words.doc: Exactly count Avro data of the schema in the bytes, as JSON values (private helper of avro:to-json).

words.name: _header
words.doc: The schema text, the codec name and the blocks (count and still compressed data) of an Avro Object Container File (private helper of avro:to-json).

words.name: decode
words.doc: Decode base64 text (RFC 4648). White space is ignored and padding is optional.

words.name: encode
words.doc: Encode bytes as base64 text (RFC 4648).

words.name: _hash
words.doc: The bcrypt string of a password with a 16-byte salt, as ASCII bytes (private helper of bcrypt:hash).

words.name: _parse
words.doc: A text report of the cost, salt and hash of a bcrypt string (private helper of bcrypt:parse).

words.name: _verify
words.doc: Whether the password matches a bcrypt string (private helper of bcrypt:compare).

words.name: _hash
words.doc: The BLAKE2b digest of the bytes, size bytes long, keyed when the key is not empty (private helper of blake2b:digest).

words.name: _hash
words.doc: The BLAKE2s digest of the bytes, size bytes long, keyed when the key is not empty (private helper of blake2s:digest).

words.name: _hash
words.doc: The BLAKE3 output of the bytes, length bytes long, keyed (32-byte key) when the key is not empty (private helper of blake3:digest).

words.name: _check-key
words.doc: Raise E_RANGE unless the key is 4 to 56 bytes (private helper of blowfish:encrypt).

words.name: _decrypt-block
words.doc: Decrypt one 8-byte block with raw Blowfish (private block function for the blockmode layer).

words.name: _encrypt-block
words.doc: Encrypt one 8-byte block with raw Blowfish (private block function for the blockmode layer).

words.name: _search
words.effect: ( tabs:bytes flags:bytes menu:bytes offset:int test:int limit:int clean:bool -- bytes )
words.doc: Run the Bombe test over all 17,576 start positions of one rotor order and return the stops, 30 bytes each (private helper of bombe:search).

words.name: _decompress
words.doc: Decompress a Brotli stream (RFC 7932) with the vendored decoder, stopping at the value limit with E_LIMIT_VALUE (private helper of brotli:decompress).

words.name: _compress
words.doc: A bzip2 stream of the bytes; level 1 to 9 is the block size in hundreds of kilobytes (private helper of bzip2:compress).

words.name: _decompress
words.doc: Decompress the bzip2 streams at the start of the bytes; with verify the block and stream CRCs must match. Stops at the value limit with E_LIMIT_VALUE (private helper of bzip2:decompress).

words.name: _decode
words.doc: The one CBOR data item (RFC 8949) in the bytes, as a JSON value (private helper of cbor:decode).

words.name: _encode
words.doc: A JSON value as deterministic CBOR (RFC 8949 section 4.2.1) (private helper of cbor:encode).

words.name: _crypt
words.effect: ( data:bytes key:bytes nonce:bytes counter:int rounds:str -- bytes )
words.doc: The ChaCha keystream XORed over the bytes, the same both ways (private helper of chacha:encrypt).

words.name: _decode
words.doc: Decode bytes with the WHATWG decoder for an encoding label (private helper of charset:decode). With fatal, invalid input is E_COERCE; otherwise U+FFFD replaces it.

words.name: _crypt
words.doc: The CipherSaber-2 XOR of the bytes under key and a 10-byte IV (private helper of ciphersaber2:encrypt and decrypt).

words.name: _ls47
words.doc: The LS47 letter-by-letter cipher on a given board (private helper of classical:ls47-encrypt and ls47-decrypt).

words.name: now-ms
words.doc: The current time as whole milliseconds since the Unix epoch (1970-01-01T00:00:00Z), from the host clock. Shared word: call it qualified from any vocabulary.

words.name: _mac
words.doc: CMAC (SP 800-38B) over AES or Triple DES (private helper of cmac:digest).

words.name: _starts
words.doc: Offsets of the blocks of COBS data, checking each block (private helper of cobs:decode).

words.name: _atan2
words.doc: The angle of the point (x, y) in radians, from -pi to pi (private helper of coords).

words.name: _math
words.doc: A trigonometric or hyperbolic function by name (sin cos tan asin atan sinh cosh asinh atanh), in radians (private helper of coords).
Product of two numbers.
Sum of two numbers.
Difference: the second value minus the top.

words.name: -rot
words.effect: ( a b c -- c a b )
words.doc: rotate the top to third
print the display form and a newline

words.name: .s
words.doc: print the stack without changing it
Float division. A zero divisor is E_DIV_ZERO.
True when the second value is less than the top.
True when the second value is at most the top.
Negation of =.
Equality; different tags are unequal except int and num, which compare exactly.
True when the second value is greater than the top.
True when the second value is at least the top.

words.name: >record
words.doc: Build a record from { key value } pairs with str keys; later duplicates win.

words.name: abs
words.doc: Absolute value.

words.name: acos
words.doc: Arc cosine, in radians. An operand outside -1 to 1 is E_RANGE. The result follows the host Math and may differ in the last digit between browsers.

words.name: all?
words.doc: whether the quotation accepts every element

words.name: and
words.doc: Logical and.

words.name: any?
words.doc: whether the quotation accepts some element

words.name: append
words.doc: A new list with the element added at the end.

words.name: asin
words.doc: Arc sine, in radians. An operand outside -1 to 1 is E_RANGE. The result follows the host Math and may differ in the last digit between browsers.

words.name: atan
words.doc: Arc tangent, in radians. The result follows the host Math and may differ in the last digit between browsers.

words.name: atan2
words.doc: Angle in radians of the point (x, y), from the x axis: y is the deeper operand. The result follows the host Math and may differ in the last digit between browsers.

words.name: band
words.doc: Bitwise and (two's complement, any width).

words.name: between?
words.doc: True when lo <= n <= hi (both ends included).

words.name: bjoin
words.doc: Join a list of bytes with a bytes separator. A non-bytes element is E_TYPE.

words.name: bnot
words.doc: Bitwise not: -n-1.

words.name: bor
words.doc: Bitwise or (two's complement, any width).

words.name: bxor
words.doc: Two ints: bitwise xor. Two bytes: xor of each data byte with the key repeated cyclically (an empty key is E_RANGE). Other tags are E_TYPE.

words.name: bytes>hex
words.doc: Lowercase hex without separators.

words.name: bytes>latin1
words.doc: One code point (U+0000..U+00FF) per byte.

words.name: bytes>list
words.doc: The bytes as a list of ints 0..255.

words.name: bytes>str
words.doc: UTF-8 decoding, strict.

words.name: call
words.doc: run a quotation

words.name: case
words.doc: run the action of the first value equal to the key

words.name: cat
words.doc: Concatenate two values of the same kind (str, bytes or list).

words.name: ceil
words.doc: Round toward positive infinity.

words.name: ceil-div
words.doc: n divided by d, rounded up: the number of groups of d needed for n items (0 for n = 0). d must be positive and n non-negative.

words.name: check-int-range
words.doc: Raises E_RANGE unless lo <= n <= hi (both ends included). The message is what, then must be lo to hi, not n: 12 checked against 0 9 for the compression level gives the compression level must be 0 to 9, not 12.

words.name: clear
words.doc: remove all values above the floor

words.name: codes>str
words.doc: A str from a list of code-point ints. An invalid or surrogate value is E_RANGE, a non-int element E_TYPE.

words.name: collect
words.doc: run a quotation and return the list of what it emitted

words.name: collect-bytes
words.doc: run a quotation and return the bytes it emitted

words.name: collect-str
words.doc: run a quotation and return the string it emitted

words.name: cond
words.doc: run the action of the first test quotation that leaves true

words.name: contains?
words.doc: True when some element of the list equals x (a linear search; an empty list has nothing).

words.name: cos
words.doc: Cosine of an angle in radians. The result follows the host Math and may differ in the last digit between browsers.

words.name: cosh
words.doc: Hyperbolic cosine. An infinite result is E_RANGE. The result follows the host Math and may differ in the last digit between browsers.

words.name: count-leading
words.doc: The number of elements at the start of items (a list, bytes or the like) for which pred ( element -- bool ) holds, stopping at the first that fails. Zero for an empty sequence.

words.name: cp>str
words.doc: The one-character string of a code point (0 to 0x10FFFF, not a surrogate: anything else is the error codes>str raises).

words.name: current-vocab
words.doc: the current vocabulary of the executing segment

words.name: dec-digit?
words.doc: True for the ASCII decimal digits 0 to 9 (codes 48 to 57).

words.name: depth
words.doc: push the number of values above the floor (before the push)

words.name: digits>int
words.doc: The integer whose digits are the elements of vals, most significant digit first, in the given radix: a positional fold. Digits are not checked against the radix. Large inputs are bounded by the integer limit (E_LIMIT_VALUE).

words.name: div
words.doc: Exact floor division of integers of any size. A zero divisor is E_DIV_ZERO.

words.name: drop
words.doc: discard the top

words.name: drop2
words.doc: discard the top pair

words.name: dup
words.doc: duplicate the top

words.name: dup2
words.effect: ( a b -- a b a b )
words.doc: duplicate the top pair

words.name: each
words.doc: for each element of a list, bytes or str

words.name: emit
words.doc: append one element to the innermost collector

words.name: emit-all
words.doc: append every element of a sequence to the innermost collector

words.name: ends-with?
words.doc: True when s ends with suffix; false (not an error) when s is shorter than suffix.

words.name: exit
words.doc: leave the current word at once

words.name: exp
words.doc: e to the power x. An infinite result is E_RANGE. The result follows the host Math and may differ in the last digit between browsers.

words.name: fail
words.doc: Raise E_USER with this message.

words.name: fail-coerce
words.doc: Raise E_COERCE: the data cannot be read as the format. The same error as raise:coerce.

words.name: fail-range
words.doc: Raise E_RANGE with the reason as the message: an argument has a bad value. The same error as raise:range.

words.name: filter
words.doc: keep elements the quotation accepts

words.name: find
words.doc: index of the first element the quotation accepts, or -1

words.name: floor
words.doc: Round toward negative infinity.

words.name: fork
words.doc: split, transform each piece, join (str or bytes data)

words.name: fpow
words.doc: Power on floats. A NaN or infinite result (a negative base with a fractional exponent, zero to a negative power, overflow) is E_RANGE. pow stays the exact integer power. The result follows the host Math and may differ in the last digit between browsers.

words.name: gcd
words.doc: Greatest common divisor, never negative; gcd(0,0) is 0.

words.name: get
words.doc: The value stored under key. A missing key is E_RANGE.

words.name: has-key?
words.doc: True when the record has the key.

words.name: help
words.doc: metadata text for a word

words.name: hex-digit?
words.doc: True for an ASCII hexadecimal digit: 0 to 9, A to F or a to f.

words.name: hex>bytes
words.doc: Parse hex digits; ASCII whitespace is ignored. An odd digit count or a non-hex character is E_COERCE.

words.name: if
words.doc: conditional

words.name: int>be-bytes
words.doc: The low n bytes of v, most significant first (big-endian); higher bytes are dropped and an n of 0 gives no bytes.

words.name: int>num
words.doc: Convert to a float. A bigint int is E_COERCE.

words.name: int>str
words.doc: Decimal text.

words.name: int>str-radix
words.doc: Text in base 2..36 with lowercase digits and - for negatives. Another radix is E_RANGE.

words.name: invmod
words.doc: Modular inverse of a mod m in [0, m). m < 1 or no inverse is E_RANGE.

words.name: join
words.doc: Join a list of str with sep. A non-str element is E_TYPE.

words.name: keys
words.doc: The keys, in insertion order.

words.name: latin1>bytes
words.doc: One byte per code point. A code point above U+00FF is E_RANGE.

words.name: len
words.doc: Length of a str (code points), bytes or list.

words.name: list>bytes
words.doc: A bytes from a list of ints 0..255 (E_RANGE or E_TYPE otherwise).

words.name: ln
words.doc: Natural logarithm. An operand of 0 or less is E_RANGE. The result follows the host Math and may differ in the last digit between browsers.

words.name: log10
words.doc: Base 10 logarithm. An operand of 0 or less is E_RANGE. The result follows the host Math and may differ in the last digit between browsers.

words.name: log2
words.doc: Base 2 logarithm. An operand of 0 or less is E_RANGE. The result follows the host Math and may differ in the last digit between browsers.

words.name: loop
words.doc: post-test loop

words.name: lower
words.doc: String.prototype.toLowerCase.

words.name: map
words.doc: transform each element (bytes results must be 0..255)

words.name: mapi
words.doc: like map; the quotation sees ( elem index )

words.name: max
words.doc: The larger of two numbers, keeping its tag. On a tie the deeper operand wins.

words.name: min
words.doc: The smaller of two numbers, keeping its tag. On a tie the deeper operand wins.

words.name: mod
words.doc: Floor modulo, with the sign of the divisor. A zero divisor is E_DIV_ZERO.

words.name: neg
words.doc: Negation. An int zero stays zero (there is no negative zero int).

words.name: nip
words.doc: drop the second

words.name: not
words.doc: Logical not.

words.name: nth
words.doc: Element i: a one-code-point str, a byte as int, or a list element. Out of range is E_RANGE.

words.name: num>int
words.doc: Convert an integral float to an int; otherwise E_COERCE.

words.name: or
words.doc: Logical or.

words.name: over
words.doc: copy the second to the top

words.name: pad-hex
words.doc: The lower-case hex digits of a non-negative integer, left-padded with zeros to at least n digits (never truncated).

words.name: pi
words.doc: The constant pi, 3.141592653589793.

words.name: pow
words.doc: Integer power. A negative exponent is E_RANGE; a result over maxIntBits is E_LIMIT_VALUE.

words.name: powmod
words.doc: base^exp mod mod in [0, mod). exp < 0 or mod < 1 is E_RANGE.

words.name: put
words.doc: A new record with the key set.

words.name: range
words.doc: { from ... to-1 }; empty if to <= from.

words.name: reduce
words.doc: fold

words.name: repeat-str
words.doc: The text s repeated n times (the empty string for 0).

words.name: rev
words.doc: Reverse a str (by code point), bytes or list.

words.name: rot
words.effect: ( a b c -- b c a )
words.doc: rotate the third to the top

words.name: round
words.doc: Round to the nearest int, halves away from zero.

words.name: see
words.doc: source or definition of a word

words.name: shl
words.doc: Shift left by k >= 0. A result over maxIntBits is E_LIMIT_VALUE, checked before computing.

words.name: shr
words.doc: Arithmetic shift right by k >= 0.

words.name: sin
words.doc: Sine of an angle in radians. The result follows the host Math and may differ in the last digit between browsers.

words.name: sinh
words.doc: Hyperbolic sine. An infinite result is E_RANGE. The result follows the host Math and may differ in the last digit between browsers.

words.name: slice
words.doc: Sub-sequence [from, to). Needs 0 <= from <= to <= len, else E_RANGE.

words.name: sort
words.doc: A new list, stably ascending: all numbers, all strings (code point order) or all bytes (lexicographic). Any other mixture or tag is E_TYPE.

words.name: sort-by
words.doc: stable sort by the key the quotation computes

words.name: space?
words.doc: True for ASCII white space: tab, line feed, vertical tab, form feed, carriage return (9 to 13) and space (32).

words.name: split
words.doc: Split at every occurrence of sep. An empty str gives { "" }; a trailing separator gives a trailing "". An empty sep is E_RANGE.

words.name: sqrt
words.doc: Square root as a float. A negative operand is E_RANGE.

words.name: starts-with?
words.doc: True when s begins with prefix; false (not an error) when s is shorter than prefix. Every string starts with the empty string.

words.name: str>bytes
words.doc: UTF-8 encoding, strict.

words.name: str>codes
words.doc: The code points of a str as a list of ints.

words.name: str>int
words.doc: Parse -?[0-9]+ as an integer; anything else is E_COERCE.

words.name: str>int-radix
words.doc: Parse -? and digits of the base (either case). A bad digit is E_COERCE, another radix E_RANGE, a result over maxIntBits E_LIMIT_VALUE.

words.name: str>num
words.doc: Parse the whole string as -?digits[.digits][e[+-]digits] into a num: no spaces, no +, no .5 or 5., no hex, no NaN or Infinity, no _. Anything else, or a value that overflows, is E_COERCE.

words.name: strip-space
words.doc: The text without any of its ASCII white space characters (see space?), wherever they are.

words.name: sum
words.doc: The sum of a list of integers (0 for the empty list). For a list of floats write the fold yourself.

words.name: swap
words.doc: exchange the top two

words.name: tan
words.doc: Tangent of an angle in radians. The result follows the host Math and may differ in the last digit between browsers.

words.name: tanh
words.doc: Hyperbolic tangent. The result follows the host Math and may differ in the last digit between browsers.

words.name: times
words.doc: repeat n times

words.name: translate
words.doc: Replace each byte b by table[b]. The table must be exactly 256 bytes (E_PARAM_INVALID).

words.name: trim-end
words.doc: The text without its trailing characters whose code satisfies pred ( code:int -- bool ).

words.name: trim-start
words.doc: The text without its leading characters whose code satisfies pred ( code:int -- bool ).

words.name: try
words.doc: run with a recovery handler

words.name: tuck
words.doc: copy the top below the second

words.name: type
words.doc: The tag name of a value.

words.name: unless
words.doc: run if false

words.name: upper
words.doc: String.prototype.toUpperCase.

words.name: vocabs
words.doc: vocabulary names, sorted by code point

words.name: when
words.doc: run if true

words.name: while
words.doc: pre-test loop

words.name: words
words.doc: public word names of a vocabulary, sorted by code point

words.name: zero-bytes
words.doc: n zero bytes (none for 0).

words.name: zip
words.doc: A list of two-element lists { a b }, as long as the shorter input.

words.name: _crc
words.effect: ( data:bytes width:int poly:int init:int refin:bool refout:bool xorout:int -- int )
words.doc: The CRC register of the bytes under the Rocksoft model (width 1 to 82, polynomial without its top bit, init, reflect in, reflect out, xor out), computed byte by byte from a table (private helper of crc:custom and crc:checksum).

words.name: _select
words.doc: Private. The outer HTML of each element of an HTML document that matches a CSS selector, in document order, as a list of str. The HTML parser repairs bad markup, so no document fails; a selector css-select cannot read is E_COERCE; a selector longer than 4096 characters is E_RANGE; a document nested deeper than 512 levels, with more than 200,000 nodes, or a result past the value limit is E_LIMIT_VALUE.

words.name: _parse
words.doc: Private. RFC 4180 text to a list of rows (lists of str). Each character of cells ends a cell and each character of rows ends a row (a CR before an LF is one row end when both are row delimiters); both strings read the escapes \r \n \t \\ and \xHH. A cell that starts with a double quote runs to the closing quote and may hold delimiters and line breaks (a doubled quote is one quote). An unterminated quote or text after a closing quote is E_COERCE with the position; empty lines are skipped.

words.name: _write
words.doc: Private. A list of rows (lists of str) as RFC 4180 text: cell between cells, row between rows (none after the last; both read the escapes of csv:_parse). A cell is quoted when it holds the delimiters, a double quote, a CR or an LF.

words.name: _zone-abbr
words.doc: The short name the host gives a time zone at an instant (private helper of the datetime vocabulary); it depends on the host's ICU data.

words.name: _zone-offset
words.doc: The offset of an IANA time zone from UTC in seconds at an instant in Unix milliseconds, from the host's Intl rules (private helper of the datetime vocabulary). An unknown zone, or an instant outside the years 1 to 9999, is E_RANGE.

words.name: _zones
words.doc: The time zone names the host supports, with UTC, sorted by code point (private helper of datetime:zones).

words.name: _deflate
words.doc: A raw DEFLATE stream of the bytes at a level from 0 (stored) to 9 (private helper of deflate:deflate and the zlib and gzip words).

words.name: _inflate
words.doc: Inflate the raw DEFLATE stream that begins at a byte offset; gives the bytes and the offset after the stream. Stops at the value limit with E_LIMIT_VALUE (private helper of deflate:inflate and the zlib and gzip words).

words.name: _check-key
words.doc: Raise E_RANGE unless the key is 8 bytes (private helper of des:encrypt).

words.name: _decrypt-block
words.doc: Decrypt one 8-byte block with raw DES (private block function for the blockmode layer).

words.name: _encrypt-block
words.doc: Encrypt one 8-byte block with raw DES (private block function for the blockmode layer).

words.name: _edits
words.doc: The edit script between two lists of strings as runs { kind a-start b-start length } (0 equal, 1 deleted from a, 2 inserted from b); Myers' difference in linear space, capped in work (private helper of diff:compare).

words.name: _levenshtein
words.effect: ( a:str b:str insertion:int deletion:int substitution:int -- int )
words.doc: Weighted edit distance from a to b over code points (private helper of distance:levenshtein).

words.name: _keygen
words.doc: The private key (1 to the order minus 1) a seed of _seed-length bytes maps to (private helper).

words.name: _public-key
words.doc: The uncompressed public point 04 || x || y of a private key (private helper).

words.name: _seed-length
words.doc: The seed length in bytes that _keygen wants for a curve (private helper).

words.name: _sign
words.doc: Deterministic (RFC 6979) ECDSA of a digest, r || s fixed width (private helper of ecdsa:sign).

words.name: _size
words.doc: The size in bytes of the order of an ECDSA curve (private helper of the ecdsa words).

words.name: _uncompressed
words.doc: The uncompressed form of a point on the curve; a point off the curve is E_COERCE (private helper).

words.name: _valid-point
words.doc: True when the bytes are a point on the curve in the compressed or uncompressed form (private helper).

words.name: _verify
words.effect: ( curve:str pub:bytes digest:bytes sig:bytes hash:str -- bool )
words.doc: True when r || s verifies over the digest (private helper of ecdsa:verify).

words.name: carve
words.doc: The files found by file signature, cut out with the end finder of their type, as records of name (extracted_at_0x<offset>.<extension>), offset, size, type (MIME) and data, in order of offset. A type with no end finder is always left out; a file that is damaged or cut short is left out with ignore-failed and E_COERCE otherwise; a file smaller than min-size bytes is left out. The sum of the sizes is bounded by the value limit (E_LIMIT_VALUE). Shared word of the filetype vocabulary.

words.name: detect-list
words.doc: The file signatures that match at offset 0 of the data, as records of offset, name, extensions, mime, description, category and weak, in table order; categories is a list of category names (Images, Video, Audio, Documents, Applications, Archives, Miscellaneous). Shared word of the filetype vocabulary.

words.name: scan-list
words.doc: Every offset of the data where a file signature matches (the file would start there), as records of offset, name, extensions, mime, description, category and weak, ordered by offset and then by table order. Signatures with a name offset (tar at 257) are reported at the start of the file. With ignore-weak the short signatures that occur by chance (MZ, ICO, MP3 frames, a shebang, ...) are left out. More matches than the value limit allows is E_LIMIT_VALUE. Shared word of the filetype vocabulary: the signature scanner that other vocabularies (YARA) reuse.

words.name: _pack
words.doc: One decimal number (or NaN, Infinity) as 4 or 8 IEEE 754 bytes (private helper of float:encode).

words.name: _unpack
words.doc: 4 or 8 IEEE 754 bytes as the shortest decimal text that reads back the same (private helper of float:decode).

words.name: _crcs
words.doc: The CRC of the data under each preset line, as hex text, one per line (private helper of generate-all:checksums).

words.name: _hash
words.doc: The GOST R 34.11-94 digest of the bytes for an S-box name, test or cryptopro (private helper of gost:digest).

words.name: _imit
words.effect: ( data:bytes key:bytes iv:bytes sbox:str size:int -- bytes )
words.doc: The GOST 28147-89 IMIT of the data, the first size bytes (1 to 8) of the register (private helper of gost-mac:sign).

words.name: _check-key
words.doc: Raise E_RANGE unless the key is 32 bytes and the S-box name is known (private helper).

words.name: _crypt-ext
words.effect: ( data:bytes key:bytes iv:bytes mode:str sbox:str mesh:bool decrypt:bool -- bytes )
words.doc: GOST 28147-89 in a mode with CryptoPro key meshing or the GOST counter mode (private helper).

words.name: _decrypt-block
words.doc: Decrypt one 8-byte block with GOST 28147-89 (private block function for the blockmode layer).

words.name: _encrypt-block
words.doc: Encrypt one 8-byte block with GOST 28147-89 (private block function for the blockmode layer).

words.name: _unwrap
words.effect: ( data:bytes kek:bytes ukm:bytes sbox:str mode:str -- bytes )
words.doc: RFC 4357 GOST 28147-89 key unwrap with the MAC check (private helper of gost28147:unwrap-key).

words.name: _wrap
words.effect: ( cek:bytes kek:bytes ukm:bytes sbox:str mode:str -- bytes )
words.doc: RFC 4357 GOST 28147-89 key wrap, CEK_ENC and CEK_MAC (private helper of gost28147:wrap-key).

words.name: _order
words.doc: The order q of a GOST R 34.10 curve (private helper).

words.name: _public-key
words.doc: The public point x || y of a private key (private helper).

words.name: _sign
words.doc: The signature r || s of a digest with the nonce k; empty when k must be replaced (private helper).

words.name: _size
words.doc: The size in bytes of the numbers of a GOST R 34.10 curve (private helper of the gost3410 words).

words.name: _verify
words.doc: True when r || s verifies over the digest (private helper).

words.name: _hash
words.doc: The HAS-160 digest of the bytes (private helper of has160:digest).

words.name: decode
words.doc: Decode pairs of hex digits (either case); white space between digits is ignored.

words.name: encode
words.doc: Encode bytes as hex digits, two per byte.

words.name: _dechunk
words.doc: The data of a chunked HTTP body (RFC 9112 section 7.1): the chunks joined, the extensions and the trailer fields skipped. Malformed or cut-short chunked data is E_COERCE with the offset (private helper of http:dechunk).

words.name: null
words.doc: The value that stands for JSON null: a record with the one key U+DFFF followed by null, which json:parse never produces from real data. FL has no null of its own. Shared word: call it qualified from any vocabulary.

words.name: null?
words.doc: True if the value is the json:null sentinel. Shared word: call it qualified from any vocabulary.

words.name: parse
words.doc: Strict RFC 8259 JSON text to a value: object to record (keys in the order written; a repeated key is E_COERCE), array to list, string to str, a number written without fraction or exponent to int (exact, big integers kept), any other number to num (out of range is E_COERCE), true and false to bool, null to the json:null sentinel. Surrounding white space is allowed; a byte order mark, a comment, a trailing comma, a lone surrogate or any text after the value is E_COERCE naming the offset, line and column. Nesting deeper than 512 is E_LIMIT_VALUE. Shared word: call it qualified from any vocabulary.

words.name: stringify
words.doc: A value as JSON text: compact for an indent of 0, else indented by that many spaces per level (0 to 32; E_RANGE otherwise), with a space after each colon. int is exact; num is the shortest text that reads back as the same number and always has a fraction or an exponent (100.0, -0.0, 1e+21); json:null is null. bytes, quotations and files have no JSON form (E_TYPE), a lone surrogate in a string is E_COERCE, and nesting deeper than 512 is E_LIMIT_VALUE. Shared word: call it qualified from any vocabulary.

words.name: _query
words.doc: Private. The result of a JSONata query over a JSON value; no result is the empty string. $random, $shuffle, $now and $millis raise an error (ops are deterministic). A syntax or evaluation error is E_COERCE with the code and position; more than 3,000,000 evaluation steps is E_LIMIT_STEPS; a stack, sequence or range overflow and a result past the value limit are E_LIMIT_VALUE.

words.name: _query
words.doc: Private. The values selected by a JSONPath (RFC 9535) query over a JSON value, as a list in the RFC's order. A malformed query is E_COERCE with the position; a query longer than 4096 characters is E_RANGE; nesting deeper than 512 and a result past the value limit are E_LIMIT_VALUE.

words.name: _on-curve
words.doc: Whether an uncompressed elliptic curve point is on the named curve (private helper of jwk:to-pem); true for the curves that have no point check (Ed25519, X25519, Ed448, X448).

words.name: _public
words.doc: The public key of a private key (private helper of jwk:from-pem): the uncompressed point 04, x, y for P-256, P-384, P-521 and secp256k1; the public key bytes for Ed25519, X25519, Ed448 and X448. A private key that is not valid for the curve is E_COERCE.

words.name: _hash
words.doc: The Keccak digest of the bytes for a size name (private helper of keccak:digest).

words.name: shuffle
words.doc: A uniform random permutation of the list (Fisher-Yates on the host CSPRNG). Shared word: call it qualified from any vocabulary.

words.name: sort
words.doc: A stable ascending sort of a list of numbers (int and num together, compared as numbers, big integers included) or of strings (by code point). A list that mixes numbers and strings, or holds anything else, is E_COERCE. Shared word: call it qualified from any vocabulary.

words.name: sort-by
words.doc: The items in the order of a stable ascending sort of their keys (all numbers or all strings, by the rules of list:sort; E_COERCE otherwise). The lists must be the same length (E_RANGE). Compute the keys with map. Shared word: call it qualified from any vocabulary.

words.name: _hash
words.doc: The LM hash of upper-cased password bytes, padded or truncated to 14 (private helper of lmhash:digest).

words.name: _blocks
words.effect: ( data:bytes start:int independent:bool block-checksum:bool max-block:int verify:bool -- bytes int )
words.doc: Decode the data blocks of an LZ4 frame from a byte offset up to its EndMark; gives the bytes and the offset after the EndMark. Stops at the value limit with E_LIMIT_VALUE (private helper of lz4:decompress).

words.name: _encode
words.effect: ( data:bytes max-block:int independent:bool block-checksum:bool level:int -- bytes )
words.doc: The data blocks of an LZ4 frame for the bytes (no EndMark), level 0 (stored) to 9 (private helper of lz4:compress).

words.name: _legacy
words.doc: Decode the blocks of a legacy LZ4 frame from a byte offset to the end of the data or the next magic number; gives the bytes and the end offset. Stops at the value limit with E_LIMIT_VALUE (private helper of lz4:decompress).

words.name: _xxh32
words.doc: XXH32 of the bytes with a 32-bit seed (private helper of the lz4 frame words).

words.name: _compress
words.doc: An .lzma (LZMA alone) stream of the bytes at a level from 1 to 9 (private helper of lzma:compress).

words.name: _decode
words.doc: Decodes an .lzma stream; gives the output and the declared size, -1 when unknown. Stops at the value limit with E_LIMIT_VALUE (private helper of lzma:decompress).

words.name: _decompress
words.doc: Decompress an LZNT1 buffer (MS-XCA 2.5). Stops at the value limit with E_LIMIT_VALUE (private helper of lznt1:decompress).

words.name: _compress
words.doc: LZString-compress UTF-8 text in a format (default, utf16, base64, uri); lz-string 1.5.0 (private helper of lzstring:compress).

words.name: _decompress
words.doc: LZString-decompress the bytes of a format to UTF-8 text; the output is capped at the value limit before the library runs (private helper of lzstring:decompress).

words.name: _hash
words.doc: The MD2 digest (RFC 1319) of the bytes (private helper of md2:digest).

words.name: _hash
words.doc: The MD4 digest (RFC 1320) of the bytes (private helper of md4:digest).

words.name: _hash
words.doc: The MD5 digest of the bytes (private helper of md5:digest).

words.name: _hash
words.doc: The MD6 digest of the bytes: size in bits (a multiple of 8, 8..512), the mode levels L (0..64) and a key of up to 64 bytes (private helper of md6:digest).

words.name: _decode
words.doc: The one MessagePack object in the bytes, as a JSON value (private helper of msgpack:decode).

words.name: _encode
words.doc: A JSON value as MessagePack (private helper of msgpack:encode).

words.name: _name
words.doc: The registry name of a number in a named table (ethertype, ip-protocol, ip-option, tcp-option, tls-content, tls-version, tls-handshake, tls-alert, tls-extension, tls-group, tls-signature, tls-point-format, tls-compression, tls-cert-compression, tls-psk-mode, tls-cipher), the empty string when the number has none, GREASE for an RFC 8701 value in the TLS tables that allow it; an unknown table is E_RANGE (private helper of the packets vocabulary).

words.name: _walk
words.effect: ( data:bytes start:int end:int skip:int width:int partial:bool what:str -- list )
words.doc: The offsets of the items of a sequence in data[start, end), each item being skip bytes, a big-endian length of width bytes (1 to 4) and that many bytes; what names the item in the error. An item that runs past the end is E_COERCE, or with partial the last offset of the list (a window outside the data is E_RANGE). Private helper of the packets vocabulary (TLS records, handshake messages, extensions).

words.name: _derive
words.effect: ( password:bytes salt:bytes size:int iterations:int hash:str -- bytes )
words.doc: PBKDF2-HMAC (RFC 8018) over the audited noble library (private helper of pbkdf2:derive).

words.name: _view
words.doc: The outline of an XML or binary Apple property list (private helper of plist:view).

words.name: _check-key
words.doc: Raise E_RANGE unless the key is 10 or 16 bytes (private helper of present:encrypt).

words.name: _decrypt-block
words.doc: Decrypt one 8-byte block with PRESENT (private block function for the blockmode layer).

words.name: _encrypt-block
words.doc: Encrypt one 8-byte block with PRESENT (private block function for the blockmode layer).

words.name: _decode
words.doc: The fields of a Protocol Buffers message without a schema, as a JSON value keyed by field number (private helper of protobuf:decode).

words.name: _scanlines
words.effect: ( text:str level:str scale:int margin:int -- bytes width:int height:int )
words.doc: The 1-bit greyscale scanlines of the QR Code of the text, for the PNG writer (private helper of qr:generate).

words.name: _svg
words.doc: The QR Code of the text as an SVG document (private helper of qr:generate).

words.name: _text
words.doc: The QR Code of the text as lines of block characters (private helper of qr:generate).

words.name: _crypt
words.doc: The Rabbit key stream (RFC 4503) XORed into the bytes (private helper of rabbit:crypt).

words.name: coerce
words.doc: Raise E_COERCE: the data cannot be read as the format (text that does not decode).

words.name: range
words.doc: Raise E_RANGE: an argument has a bad value.

words.name: below
words.doc: A uniform random integer in [0, n) from the host CSPRNG, by rejection sampling so there is no modulo bias. n is 1 or more (E_RANGE otherwise) and may be a big integer. Shared word: call it qualified from any vocabulary.

words.name: bytes-of
words.doc: n random bytes from the host CSPRNG (n of 0 or more; E_RANGE below 0, E_LIMIT_VALUE above the value limit). Shared word: call it qualified from any vocabulary.

words.name: _check-key
words.doc: Raise E_RANGE unless the key is 1 to 128 bytes and the effective bits 1 to 1024 (private helper of rc2:encrypt).

words.name: _decrypt-block
words.doc: Decrypt one 8-byte block with raw RC2 (private block function for the blockmode layer).

words.name: _encrypt-block
words.doc: Encrypt one 8-byte block with raw RC2 (private block function for the blockmode layer).

words.name: _crypt
words.doc: RC4 of the bytes under a key after dropping the first n key stream bytes (private helper of rc4:crypt).

words.name: _check-key
words.doc: Raise E_RANGE unless the key is at most 255 bytes, the word size a multiple of 8 from 8 to 256 and the rounds 1 to 255 (private helper of rc6:encrypt).

words.name: _decrypt-block
words.doc: Decrypt one block (w / 2 bytes) with raw RC6-w/r (private block function for the blockmode layer).

words.name: _encrypt-block
words.doc: Encrypt one block (w / 2 bytes) with raw RC6-w/r (private block function for the blockmode layer).

words.name: _split-matches
words.doc: Split the data into gap, match, gap, ... pieces at the non-empty regex matches.

words.name: find-all
words.doc: Every match as a record with start, end (code points, end exclusive), text and groups. Empty matches are included.

words.name: replace
words.doc: Replace every match. The replacement follows ECMAScript's substitution rules.

words.name: split
words.doc: The pieces between the non-empty matches. Empty matches never split.

words.name: test
words.doc: True when the pattern matches anywhere in the text.

words.name: _hash
words.doc: The RIPEMD-128, -256 or -320 digest of the bytes for a size name (private helper of ripemd:digest).

words.name: _hash
words.doc: The RIPEMD-160 digest of the bytes (private helper of ripemd160:digest).

words.name: _decode
words.doc: Rison, O-Rison or A-Rison text as a JSON value (private helper of rison:decode).

words.name: _encode
words.doc: A JSON value as Rison, O-Rison or A-Rison text (private helper of rison:encode).

words.name: _quote
words.doc: Rison text made safe for a URI, as rison.js quote does (private helper of rison:encode).

words.name: _prime
words.doc: The first probable prime of the given size among the candidates cut from the random pool, or 0 (private helper of rsa:generate-key-pair).

words.name: _crypt
words.doc: The Salsa20 keystream XORed over the bytes, the same both ways (private helper of salsa20:encrypt).

words.name: _derive
words.effect: ( password:bytes salt:bytes n:int r:int p:int length:int -- bytes )
words.doc: scrypt (RFC 7914) over the audited noble library (private helper of scrypt:derive).

words.name: _hash
words.doc: The SHA-0 digest (FIPS 180, 1993) of the bytes (private helper of sha0:digest).

words.name: _hash
words.doc: The SHA-1 digest of the bytes (private helper of sha1:digest).

words.name: _hash
words.doc: The SHA-2 digest of the bytes for a size name (private helper of sha2:digest).

words.name: _hash
words.doc: The SHA-3 digest of the bytes for a size name (private helper of sha3:digest).

words.name: _hash
words.doc: The SHAKE output of the bytes for a variant and a length in bytes (private helper of shake:digest).

words.name: _run
words.effect: ( data:bytes cipher:bytes control:bytes state:bytes index:bytes decrypt:bool -- bytes )
words.doc: Run the SIGABA rotor stack over letters 0 to 25 (private helper of sigaba:crypt).

words.name: _mul
words.doc: k times a point on the SM2 curve, both as in _mul-base (private helper).

words.name: _mul-base
words.doc: k times the base point as 04 || x || y, k being 32 bytes from 1 to n - 1 (private helper).

words.name: _order
words.doc: The order n of the SM2 curve (private helper of the sm2 words).

words.name: _valid-point
words.doc: True when the bytes are 04 || x || y of a point on the SM2 curve (private helper).

words.name: _hash
words.doc: The SM3 digest of the bytes (private helper of sm3:digest).

words.name: _check-key
words.doc: Raise E_RANGE unless the key is 16 bytes (private helper of sm4:encrypt).

words.name: _decrypt-block
words.doc: Decrypt one 16-byte block with raw SM4 (private block function for the blockmode layer).

words.name: _encrypt-block
words.doc: Encrypt one 16-byte block with raw SM4 (private block function for the blockmode layer).

words.name: _hash
words.doc: The Snefru digest of the bytes for a size (128 or 256) and a pass count (2 to 8) (private helper of snefru:digest).

words.name: _pieces
words.doc: One pass of context triggered piecewise hashing at a block size (private helper of ssdeep:digest).

words.name: _hash
words.doc: The GOST R 34.11-2012 (Streebog) digest of the bytes for a size, 256 or 512 (private helper of streebog:digest).

words.name: _headers
words.doc: The offsets of the headers of a tar archive, checked (private helper of tar:untar and tar:entry).

words.name: _oct
words.doc: The value of an octal header field (private helper of the tar words).

words.name: _sum
words.doc: The sum of the bytes (private helper of the tar header checksum).

words.name: _check-key
words.doc: Raise E_RANGE unless the key is 16 bytes (private helper of tea:encrypt).

words.name: _decrypt-block
words.doc: Decrypt one 8-byte block with TEA (private block function for the blockmode layer).

words.name: _encrypt-block
words.doc: Encrypt one 8-byte block with TEA (private block function for the blockmode layer).

words.name: _render
words.doc: Private. Render a Handlebars-style template (a documented subset: variables, if/unless/each/with/lookup, Mustache sections, comments, white-space control) against a JSON value. Output of {{x}} is HTML-escaped. No code is generated or run. A syntax error or an unsupported feature is E_COERCE with the line and column; blocks nested deeper than 100 and output past the value limit are E_LIMIT_VALUE; more than 5,000,000 render steps is E_LIMIT_STEPS.

words.name: _parse
words.doc: The tag-length-value elements of the bytes as records of key, length and value (private helper of tlv:parse).

words.name: _check-key
words.doc: Raise E_RANGE unless the key is 16 or 24 bytes (private helper of triple-des:encrypt).

words.name: _decrypt-block
words.doc: Decrypt one 8-byte block with raw Triple DES, EDE (private block function for the blockmode layer).

words.name: _encrypt-block
words.doc: Encrypt one 8-byte block with raw Triple DES, EDE (private block function for the blockmode layer).

words.name: _check-key
words.doc: Raise E_RANGE unless the key is 16, 24 or 32 bytes (private helper of twofish:encrypt).

words.name: _decrypt-block
words.doc: Decrypt one 16-byte block with raw Twofish (private block function for the blockmode layer).

words.name: _encrypt-block
words.doc: Encrypt one 16-byte block with raw Twofish (private block function for the blockmode layer).

words.name: _normalize
words.doc: Unicode normalisation (UAX #15) to nfc, nfd, nfkc or nfkd (private helper of unicode:normalize).

words.name: _hash
words.doc: The Whirlpool digest of the bytes (private helper of whirlpool:digest).

words.name: _query
words.doc: Private. The result of an XPath 1.0 expression over an XML document as a list of str: the serialisation of each selected node in document order, or the one text of a number, string or boolean result. A document that is not well formed or a bad expression is E_COERCE; an expression longer than 4096 characters is E_RANGE; a document nested deeper than 512 levels, with more than 200,000 nodes, or a result past the value limit is E_LIMIT_VALUE.

words.name: _huffman
words.doc: Decompress XPRESS LZ77+Huffman data (MS-XCA 2.2). Stops at the value limit with E_LIMIT_VALUE (private helper of xpress:huffman-decompress).

words.name: _lz77
words.doc: Decompress XPRESS Plain LZ77 data (MS-XCA 2.4). Stops at the value limit with E_LIMIT_VALUE (private helper of xpress:decompress).

words.name: _crypt
words.doc: The XSalsa20 keystream XORed over the bytes, the same both ways (private helper of xsalsa20:encrypt).

words.name: _check-key
words.doc: Raise E_RANGE unless the key is 16 bytes (private helper of xtea:encrypt).

words.name: _decrypt-block
words.doc: Decrypt one 8-byte block with XTEA (private block function for the blockmode layer).

words.name: _encrypt-block
words.doc: Encrypt one 8-byte block with XTEA (private block function for the blockmode layer).

words.name: _decrypt
words.doc: XXTEA decryption, trimmed to the stored length (private helper of xxtea:decrypt).

words.name: _encrypt
words.doc: XXTEA (Corrected Block TEA) encryption with the length word appended (private helper of xxtea:encrypt).

words.name: _dump
words.doc: Private. A value as YAML text: block style, 2-space indent, single quotes, every string that YAML 1.1 or 1.2 would read as another type quoted. bytes, quotations and files have no YAML form (E_TYPE).

words.name: _parse
words.doc: Private. One YAML 1.2 document (core schema) to a value: mapping to record, sequence to list, integer to int (exact), float to num, null to json:null. An empty stream is null; more than one document, a syntax error, a repeated key, .inf and .nan are E_COERCE with the position; nesting deeper than 512 and an alias expansion past the value limit are E_LIMIT_VALUE.

words.name: _scan
words.doc: Scan the data with YARA rules (a documented subset): one record per matching, non-private rule with name, tags, meta (key, value, kind) and strings (id, count, matches: offset, length, text). Rules outside the subset are E_COERCE with the line and column (private helper of yara:scan).

words.name: _cd-offsets
words.doc: The offsets of the n central directory entries that start at cdoff, each checked for its signature (private helper of zip:unzip and zip:entry).

words.name: _extract
words.doc: The bytes of several zip entries, each given as { start size method }, under one budget of the value limit: stops with E_LIMIT_VALUE when the sum passes it (private helper of zip:unzip and zip:entry).

words.name: _decompress
words.doc: Decompress a zstd stream (every frame, skippable frames skipped), checking each frame's content checksum when verify is true. Stops at the value limit with E_LIMIT_VALUE (private helper of zstd:decompress).
